summary: Frontend testing as QA admin of the contact Role select and the 'Tipo de Integrador' select. All 5 requested flows pass. (1) Wizard, New Integrator: wizard-integrator-type is a select with exactly [Integrador, Comercio]; the locked element no longer renders; wizard-integration-type still offers CR/LP/PG/MP/TK; selecting Comercio works. (2) Wizard, existing Galac -> wizard-scope-new-type: the select comes pre-selected with 'Integrador' (the current value) and can be changed to Comercio. (3) wizard-resp-role and wizard-resp-role-1 (after wizard-add-new-contact-btn) offer exactly Rol..., Contacto Principal, Responsable Técnico, Contacto Administrativo, Comercial. (4) Directorio new-company-btn: created 'QA Roles Empresa T1' with 2 contacts (Contacto Administrativo, Responsable Técnico); POST returned 200 with both roles saved. After the role was set to 'Director' via API, the Ficha showed company-contact-role-0 with 'Director' as an extra option and selected; the 4 standard options were still there. (5) Project detail prj_1b982687dfb5: edit-project-techs-btn -> pd-tech-add-btn -> pd-tech-role-0 has the 4 options; saved 'QA Tecnico T1 / Responsable Técnico', and the view shows the role badge, so it persisted. /direct-projects: after picking dp-integrator, dp-tech-role-0 has the 4 options and selecting Comercial works. The direct project was NOT submitted, to avoid creating a real project. The wizard was cancelled and never submitted.

design_issues.screen: Asistente Nuevo Proyecto de Integración - contact rows
issues: The Role select is col-span-2 and too narrow: 'Comercial' is cut to 'Comercia', and 'Contacto Principal' and 'Contacto Administrativo' will be cut too. Widen it (e.g. Name col-span-3, Email col-span-2 or 3, Role col-span-3) or shorten the labels.

design_issues.screen: Asistente - switching from New Integrator to an existing integrator
issues: Minor: new-contact rows typed in New Integrator mode stay in the list after switching to an existing integrator (Galac). Consider resetting contacts when the selected integrator changes.
The page is blank because there is no 404 or fallback route. The real route is /direct-projects.

action_items: Widen the wizard contact Role select (WizardContactsPicker.jsx line 78, col-span-2) so the full role names are visible
Optional: reset formData.contacts when the integrator selection or wizard mode changes
Optional: add a catch-all route (404 or redirect) in App.js
critical_code_review_comments: ContactRoleSelect is a shared component that keeps legacy roles as an extra option. Good design.

Integrators.jsx line 543: if an existing integrator_type is outside [Integrador, Comercio], the select shows empty and the user must choose again. All DB values are already Integrador/Comercio, so there is no impact today.
Integrators.jsx is very large (>2000 lines) and should be split.
